The evidence concerns the software product **Locales.ai** at the domain **locales.ai** (AI-powered website and app localization services).

### Directly Providing Vendor
The operating company and developer directly providing **Locales.ai** is **AGI Forge Global, Inc.** (operating under the corporate brand **AGIForge**).

### Provider Statements & Evidence
* **Official Website Legal Policies & Support:** The official Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, and help documentation across `locales.ai` direct all support, legal, and operational inquiries to AGIForge (`support@agiforge.com`): 
  * *"To ask questions or comment about this privacy policy and our privacy practices, contact us at: support@agiforge.com."*
  * *"All refund requests should be submitted within 30 days from the date of purchase, via email to support@agiforge.com..."*
* **App Store Publisher Listing:** Official marketplace distributions for the tool (such as on the Shopify App Store for *Locales.ai: AI Translate*) explicitly identify the registered developer and company as **AGI Forge Global, Inc.**.
